title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

PLEASE APPLY WITH YOUR ENGLISH CV


The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.
  • You have a \"Builder\" mentality—you enjoy solving the complex math and logic behind Risk Management.
  • You don't just fix bugs; you identify systemic risks and propose architectural improvements.


LUXOFT ONLY OPERATES UNDER CLT CONTRACT

Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva

title: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.


  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.


  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.


  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.


  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.
  • Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente #Numen.


Prezamos por pessoas que:


Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;


Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;


Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;


E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na #Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser #Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo


#VemSerNumen

Responsabilidades e Atribuições


Suas principais atividades serão: Participar de projetos de implementação, melhorias, rollout;

Executar as atividades de projeto de acordo com o planejamento: Desenho/detalhamento de soluções, configurações, testes, documentações, suporte ao cliente;

Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução; Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto; Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes; · Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.


Requisitos e Qualificações


Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.


Para se candidatar você precisa dos seguintes requisitos e qualificações:


· Sólidos conhecimentos em SAP FI

· Experiencia com migração de dados e integração.

· Participação em projetos de Implementação, Rollouts, Melhorias, Upgrades.

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Gerente de Vendas de Canais CCaaS (SCM)
description:
Somos a net2phone, uma provedora líder de serviços de comunicação em nuvem e experiência do cliente (CXaaS). Com mais de 30 anos de experiência e o respaldo da rede global da IDT, oferecemos serviços de comunicação em nuvem (UCaaS e CCaaS) juntamente com poderosas soluções de IA para experiência do cliente, garantindo eficiência, confiabilidade e a mais alta qualidade de serviço.


Estamos buscando um(a) Gerente de Vendas de Canais CCaaS (SCM)


Descrição do cargo:

O principal desafio do cargo será atuar na identificação das necessidades do call center/Contact center relativas a prestação de serviços a seus Clientes, para elaboração e desenvolvimento de propostas que atendam aos requisitos relativos à plataforma de serviços, produto, integrações e recursos de inteligência artificial aplicaveis ao sistema do Cliente.. 

Requisitos:

-   Experiência comercial em projetos de telefonia, plataformas de serviços de call centers/contact centers e suas integrações;

-  Conhecimentos nas áreas de tecnologia dos produtos voltados para atendimento de serviços de call centers/contact centers;

-  Vivência com integradores de soluções para Call Centers/Contact Centers;

-   Nível intermediário de inglês

Principais funções: 

-   Busca de integradores e clientes de call centers/contact centers;

-   Compreender as necessidades do cliente e projetar soluções sob medida;

-   Realizar apresentações de produtos e elaborar propostas técnicas/comerciais para os clientes;

-  Assessorar Integradores e clientes sobre os produtos e serviços net2phone;

-  Realizar o processo de vendas, interagindo com as diferentes áreas internas envolvidas para dimensionar o escopo do projeto e elaborar a proposta sob medida;

-   Administrar o pipeline da linha de negócios, com o objetivo de alcançar o cumprimento das metas;

-  Obter conteúdo sobre os produtos da concorrência para colaborar com o departamento de marketing/Desenvolvimento;

-   Elaborar apresentações em conjunto com a equipe de Marketing/Prevendas;

-   Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos para Agentes e Integradores de soluções;

-   Analisar licitações e requisitos das propostas.

Competências e conhecimentos:

- Capacidade de se adaptar, aprender e aplicar estratégias de vendas de forma eficaz;

- Habilidades de comunicação, tanto dentro da empresa quanto com clientes e integradores;

- Oferecer um alto nível de atendimento ao cliente;

- Ser organizado, decidido, proativo e orientado para o resultado, sendo capaz de trabalhar autonomamente e em equipe;

- Amplo conhecimento em soluções de Call Center e Contact Center e integrações de soluções de comunicação com outros sistemas do cliente, como CRM, WhatsApp e redes sociais.

description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito?


Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente #Numen.


Prezamos por pessoas que:


Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;


Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;


Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;


E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na #Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser #Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo


#VemSerNumen

Responsabilidades e Atribuições


Suas principais atividades serão: Participar de projetos de implementação, melhorias, rollout;

Executar as atividades de projeto de acordo com o planejamento: Desenho/detalhamento de soluções, configurações, testes, documentações, suporte ao cliente;

Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução; Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto; Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes; · Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.


Requisitos e Qualificações


Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.


Para se candidatar você precisa dos seguintes requisitos e qualificações:


· Sólidos conhecimentos em SAP FI

· Experiencia com migração de dados e integração.

· Participação em projetos de Implementação, Rollouts, Melhorias, Upgrades.

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.


Imprescindível inglês avançado.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: Consultor SAP FI Sênior - inglês avançado

#VemSerNumen

Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução; Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto; Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes; · Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.

Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.

· Sólidos conhecimentos em SAP FI

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.


Imprescindível inglês avançado.

title: Consultor SAP FI Sênior - inglês avançado
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito?


Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente #Numen.


Prezamos por pessoas que:


Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;


Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;


Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;


E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na #Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser #Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo


#VemSerNumen

Responsabilidades e Atribuições


Suas principais atividades serão: Participar de projetos de implementação, melhorias, rollout;

Executar as atividades de projeto de acordo com o planejamento: Desenho/detalhamento de soluções, configurações, testes, documentações, suporte ao cliente;

Suportar a preparação e realização dos testes integrados e de regressão aos usuários-chave e analistas de TI, para validação da solução implementada;

Elaborar as documentações requeridas pelo projeto: Configurações, testes, desenho/detalhamento de soluções, atas, especificações funcionais, apresentações, entre outros;

Treinar os usuários chaves e/ou analistas de TI;

Identificar oportunidades e propor soluções e melhorias;

Buscar conhecimento necessário para garantir a melhor solução; Mapear riscos técnicos do projeto; Propor/Realizar/Participar de treinamentos;

Cumprir as normas e procedimentos da Numen e seus clientes; · Desenvolver consultores menos experientes.


Requisitos e Qualificações


Aqui na Numen, você fará parte do time e terá oportunidade de se desenvolver participando de diferentes tipos de projetos, buscamos talentos que se identificam com os nossos valores e estão em busca de desafios em um ambiente colaborativo e acolhedor no qual é possível ensinar e aprender.


Desde a fundação em 2009 nosso crescimento é exponencial, resultado de projetos de sucesso em clientes conquistados ao longo dos anos.


Temos operações no Brasil, Estados Unidos e em Portugal.


Para se candidatar você precisa dos seguintes requisitos e qualificações:


· Sólidos conhecimentos em SAP FI

· Experiencia com migração de dados e integração.

· Participação em projetos de Implementação, Rollouts, Melhorias, Upgrades.

· Deve ter feito ao menos um projeto de implementação de ponta a ponta.


Imprescindível inglês avançado.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Senior Software Engineer com forte experiência em Python/FastAPI para liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de novas features, integrações e a evolução arquitetural da nossa plataforma.

Esperamos alguém que tome decisões arquiteturais, defina padrões para o time, mentore engenheiros menos sêniores e trabalhe lado a lado com fundadores e CTO em decisões de produto e infraestrutura.


Sobre a empresa

Somos uma startup de Agentic AI atuando no varejo enterprise no Brasil. Construímos agentes que operam 24/7 em produção, processando volume relevante para grandes redes. Estamos em fase de escala — cada decisão arquitetural tomada hoje impacta nossa capacidade de crescer nos próximos 18-24 meses.


Mais detalhes sobre clientes, parcerias e roadmap são compartilhados durante o processo seletivo, essa é uma oportunidade de trabalhar com IA para as maiores empresa do Brasil.


Responsabilidades


  • Liderar tecnicamente a evolução do backend da plataforma
  • Desenhar e implementar sistemas distribuídos escaláveis em produção
  • Arquitetar integrações críticas com sistemas de terceiros
  • Definir padrões de código, testes e observabilidade do time
  • Mentorar engenheiros pleno e júnior, elevando a barra técnica
  • Trabalhar com CTO e fundadores em decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo
  • Garantir confiabilidade, performance e segurança de sistemas transacionais



Stack


  • Linguagem: Python
  • Framework: FastAPI
  • Infraestrutura: Google Cloud Platform
  • Banco de dados: PostgreSQL
  • Práticas: observabilidade ponta a ponta, CI/CD, evals para sistemas não-determinísticos



Perfil Ideal


  • 6+ anos construindo backends em produção, sendo pelo menos 2 como referência técnica de um time
  • Domínio sólido de Python e frameworks assíncronos (FastAPI, asyncio)
  • Experiência desenhando arquiteturas escaláveis e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, filas, eventos)
  • Forte experiência com Google Cloud Platform (ou equivalente em AWS/Azure)
  • Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, JWT, SSO) e SQL avançado
  • Experiência integrando APIs externas complexas em produção (webhooks, rate limits, retries, idempotência)
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas com tradeoffs claros e comunicá-las ao time



Diferenciais


  • Experiência construindo features com LLMs em produção (orquestração de agentes, tool use, evals)
  • Experiência em fintech, varejo ou marketplaces
  • Experiência prévia em startup early-stage



Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto
  • Contrato PJ
  • Remuneração competitiva
