title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Especialista Segurança do Trabalho (Logística)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú



O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil



No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time?

Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Localidade:


Mato Grosso do Sul



Desafio:


Aplicar as estratégias de Segurança do trabalho e Emergências, trabalhando na prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde ocupacional, fazendo cumprir as normas de segurança, monitorando indicadores, se antecipando e evitando situações de Emergências e/ou acidentes, garantindo a consolidação da cultura de segurança, visando um ambiente seguro para todos os colaboradores e minimizando riscos operacionais em sua área de atuação (Fábrica ou Logística ou Porto).



Principais Atividades:


  • Elaborar, implementar, manter e garantir a aprovação de políticas, programas e procedimentos de Segurança do Trabalho, assegurando conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e atendimento às necessidades das áreas de atuação (Fábrica, Logística e Porto), promovendo a cultura de segurança.
  • Identificar, avaliar e controlar riscos ocupacionais por meio de APRs, inspeções de segurança e estudos de impacto, desenvolvendo planos de ação para mitigação ou eliminação de riscos, tais como: exposição a agentes químicos, trabalho em altura, incêndio, movimentação de cargas, operação de empilhadeiras, manobra ferroviária, entre outros.
  • Definir, gerenciar e fiscalizar o uso adequado de EPIs, garantindo conformidade com a NR‑6, incluindo gestão de contratos, treinamentos, conscientização dos colaboradores e acompanhamento da utilização correta.
  • Planejar, organizar e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e periódicos (NR‑10, NR‑11, NR‑12, NR‑33, NR‑35, entre outros), além de campanhas educativas de segurança, saúde ocupacional, emergências e direção defensiva para motoristas e operadores.
  • Capacitar equipes de emergência e primeiros socorros, preparando os colaboradores para atuação em situações críticas e acidentes.
  • Realizar inspeções sistemáticas em armazéns, pátios, veículos, equipamentos, máquinas e infraestrutura, assegurando conformidade com as NRs, legislação vigente e padrões internos de segurança.
  • Coordenar auditorias internas, externas e de certificação (OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001), bem como gerenciar planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Investigar acidentes e incidentes, aplicando metodologias definidas, elaborando relatórios técnicos, revisando procedimentos e promovendo treinamentos preventivos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar programas de segurança e direção defensiva para transporte rodoviário, monitorando a condução de motoristas, uso de tacógrafos, sistemas de rastreamento e cumprimento das normas de trânsito.
  • Garantir a segurança na movimentação de cargas (amarração, empilhamento, carga e descarga), prevenindo acidentes operacionais e danos aos produtos.
  • Supervisionar o uso de empilhadeiras e equipamentos de movimentação, assegurando que os operadores estejam devidamente treinados e certificados conforme a NR‑11.
  • Monitorar, analisar e reportar indicadores de segurança (acidentes, incidentes, absenteísmo, taxa de frequência e gravidade), propondo ações preventivas e corretivas.
  • Implementar e manter programas legais de SST, como PPRA (NR‑9), PCMSO (NR‑7) e LTCAT, assegurando o monitoramento dos ambientes de trabalho e a correta aplicação de medidas de proteção.
  • Supervisionar a atuação de empresas terceirizadas e prestadores de serviços, garantindo conformidade com as normas de segurança, políticas corporativas e realização de integrações e treinamentos obrigatórios.
  • Elaborar, implementar e testar o Plano de Atendimento a Emergências (PAE), coordenando simulados, avaliando tempos de resposta, evacuação e ajustando procedimentos e sistemas conforme necessário.
  • Coordenar a CIPA (NR‑5), garantindo sua eleição, capacitação, funcionamento, reuniões periódicas e implementação das ações preventivas propostas.
  • Garantir a integridade e conformidade dos sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndio, realizando inspeções e acompanhando manutenções de extintores, hidrantes, sprinklers, alarmes e demais dispositivos.
  • Gerenciar exigências de fiscalizações e auditorias, assegurando atendimento às conformidades legais e tratamento eficaz das não conformidades.
  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e utilizar KPIs de Segurança do Trabalho para avaliação da eficácia das ações e suporte à melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a área de Saúde Ocupacional, apoiando campanhas preventivas, avaliações ergonômicas e ações para redução de LER/DORT e demais doenças ocupacionais.
  • Manter atualizada toda a documentação legal e técnica de SST, bem como elaborar relatórios gerenciais periódicos para apresentação à liderança.
  • Acompanhar alterações na legislação de Segurança do Trabalho, ajustando políticas, procedimentos e práticas internas conforme necessário.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria, inovação, modernização de processos e sistemas de Segurança do Trabalho e Emergências, visando automação, eficiência operacional e otimização de custos.
  • Garantir o cumprimento e a disseminação das políticas de Meio Ambiente, Qualidade, Segurança, Saúde Ocupacional, Ética e Compliance, junto a colaboradores próprios e terceiros.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas à função.



Requisitos e Qualificações


  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia de segurança do trabalho e afins;
  • Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho
  • Conhecimento em gestão SIF (Serious, Injuries and Fatalities)
  • Excel intermediário
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de BI
  • Conhecimentos SAP



Diferencial


  • Conhecimento de programas de gestão comportamental, confiabilidade humana e Hearts and minds;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de crises;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de PSM (Process, Safety e Management);
  • Inglês nível avançado
  • Espanhol

title: SRE - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa SRE Pleno. Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

title: SRE - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa SRE Pleno. Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

title: Staff ML Engineer - Contract
description:
Signify has partnered with a key client who is currently hiring a Staff ML Engineer to drive the productionisation and scaling of ML systems.


Staff ML Engineer (Contract)

Remote | 3–6 months | ASAP Start

Location - Remote - (The team is based on the East Coast)


What you’ll do

  • Own end-to-end ML productionisation (deployment → serving → monitoring)
  • Build and scale batch & real-time model serving systems
  • Develop feature pipelines & feature serving infrastructure
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML (build, test, deploy)

  • Experience with AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes
  • Solid understanding of ML systems, pipelines & lifecycle management
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CDK)


If you are interested in this role, then please apply or send me a message.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)

title: SRE - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa SRE Pleno. Essa pessoa atuará no time de MLOps, responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da infraestrutura que suporta os modelos e pipelines de Machine Learning em produção. Trabalhamos em um ambiente colaborativo, com forte cultura de engenharia e incentivo ao desenvolvimento contínuo. Tudo isso em uma empresa líder no mercado brasileiro de farmácia, referência em Saúde e Bem-estar com mais 3.000 lojas em todos os estados brasileiros.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsabilidades:


  • Implementar e manter infraestrutura como código utilizando Terraform, seguindo padrões e boas práticas já estabelecidos pelo time.
  • Operar e dar manutenção em clusters Kubernetes, utilizando Helm e práticas de GitOps para suporte à entrega contínua de aplicações.
  • Atuar na operação do dia a dia de ambientes AWS, contribuindo para a disponibilidade e estabilidade das plataformas.
  • Apoiar o diagnóstico de problemas de rede em cloud providers, atuando em conjunto com membros mais sêniores do time em cenários mais complexos.
  • Manter pipelines de CI/CD com GitLab, colaborando com times de desenvolvimento e dados.
  • Acompanhar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) para identificar anomalias e apoiar a resposta a incidentes.
  • Participar de processos de resposta a incidentes e post-mortems, contribuindo com análises e implementação de melhorias.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de FinOps, auxiliando na identificação de oportunidades de otimização de custos na nuvem.


Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos Técnicos


Obrigatórios


  • Experiência prática com Terraform para gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código.
  • Conhecimento sólido em AWS.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo uso de Helm e fluxos GitOps.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em GitLab (pipelines, CI/CD, repositórios).
  • Capacidade de diagnóstico em redes em ambientes cloud (VPC, security groups, DNS, load balancers, etc.).
  • Bom domínio de Linux e administração de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana e Datadog.


Diferenciais:


  • Conhecimento introdutório de práticas de FinOps em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência ou interesse em ambientes de MLOps ou Data EngineeringPerfil comportamental
  • Boa capacidade de resolução de problemas e raciocínio analítico, com vontade de evoluir em cenários de infraestrutura e sistemas distribuídos.
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Perfil com senso de dono, proativo e aberto a aprender com o time.

title: Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.


Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain , a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.


Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

• Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

• Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

• Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

• Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

• Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.


Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

• Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

• Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

• Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

• Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

• Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

• Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

• Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

• Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.


Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

• Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

• Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.


Must Have

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

• Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

• Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

• Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

• Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

• Availability to travel.

• Legally authorized to work in Brazil.


What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

• A collaborative and international work environment.

• Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.


Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

  • Contrato temporário

Benefícios
